editorRuntimeSync: Level Editor wrapper restored; Lose End Card image/text use Y=0 reference in editor and runtime

obstaclePrefabs.preview: live SVG rendered from prefab object code; no generated thumbnail images

defaultImport: Exact configuration from uploaded playable; current builder/editor features preserved
level4Physics: continuous shield support; repeated contact without per-touch kick; Level 4 obstacle ball remains solid against non-interactable walls
nonInteractableCollision: non-interactable obstacles are immovable physical colliders for obstacle bodies; protector/shield passes through them; swept collision prevents dynamic obstacles tunneling through thin walls
obstacleInteractionPhysics: enabled by default; dynamic obstacles transfer mass-weighted impulse, friction and spin to other interactable obstacles; kinematic neighbours wake on impact; four solver passes stabilize clusters
endCardRepair: full-device editor viewport; stable central active zone; gameplay HUD and CTA suppressed while End Card is visible

endCardLayoutFix.activeZone: editor-only visual guide; does not affect Level Editor layout

exportOptimization.rasterCompression: WebP with max dimension 1280 and original fallback when conversion is not smaller
exportOptimization.customAudioCompression: large uncompressed uploads are downmixed/resampled when the result is smaller
exportOptimization.dynamicBundle: only assets used by the current configuration are embedded
exportOptimization.sizeIndicator: shows final MB against 5 MB after export

serviceMenu.title: Служебное
serviceMenu.runtimeRouting: iOS devices use iOS URL; other devices use Android URL; missing URL falls back to the other platform

networkExport.assetOptimization: shared prepared base reused across all network builds
networkExport.storeLinks: Android/iOS URLs are embedded into every network build with platform fallback and URL normalization
networkExport.clickGate: 1cl exits and locks gameplay on the first user click; 2cl on the second; xcl uses configured count
networkExport.singleFileMraid: AppLovin, Moloco and UnityAds HTML do not depend on a local mraid.js file; injected SDK is used when available

rightInspectorScroll: independent vertical scroll with fixed download bar, matching the left navigation behavior

collisionForceControl.effect: very low obstacle-to-obstacle impulse transfer; 0 disables transferred momentum while keeping solid overlap resolution
